_README: External high-frequency dielectric constants (eps_inf) for the Wannier-Mott exciton binding (Theme I, option c). Extracted ONLY from cited sources (no fabricated values). In-repo references (references/texts/) yielded only a lead-iodide proxy; the rest are pending Cowork Claude-in-Chrome search (directive supplement 2026-05-24_0735). PI decision (v): Cowork fills missing materials via Chrome (Materials Project / NoMaD / Scholar / arXiv).
_searched_texts: references/texts/*.txt (61 files); keywords: high-frequency/optical dielectric, epsilon_inf, eps_inf, refractive index, varepsilon_infty, per material
_workflow: Claude Code marks not-found as pending_cowork_chrome_search and writes *_eps_inf_missing_request.md; Cowork appends cited values here via Chrome; Claude Code re-runs Y1-c-3 next polling cycle.

CsPbI3.source: Cho et al. 2019, arXiv:1908.09436 (text ~line 224, 'epsilon = 6.1'); arXiv:2210.01324 (lines 119/190, 'dielectric constant eps_p = 6.1', stated as bulk MAPbI3 high-frequency dielectric)
CsPbI3.method: effective exciton screening (eps_p) for lead-iodide perovskite (MAPbI3)
CsPbI3.phase: reference is MAPbI3, not cubic CsPbI3
CsPbI3.notes: NOT a measured CsPbI3 eps_inf; effective dielectric (between eps_inf and eps_static). Rough proxy only; Cowork may replace with a CsPbI3-specific cited value.
